scope: Exhaustive reconciliation and experimental-port evidence; no official #2734 wave delivery, typed-Principal/router convergence, CLI-write cutover, crate/Windows or multi-Daemon registry implementation.

evidence.G1: Final-head all-feature nextest5344/6skip incl E2E; separate E2E186/3ignored; fmt/clippy/build/Nix47 green.
evidence.G2: Final-head web format951/lint/build/test-types/matrix; Vitest3896/346files; mocked322/live141 zero unexpected/flaky/skipped.
evidence.P1: Final-head actual TUI/Core/tmux20transitions, 2s target; no-write/no-reacquire/offline/explicit-reconnect causal proof.
evidence.P2: Final-head actual MCP5modes, ownerUDS, REST equality/order unchanged, TCP401/200, CityHall403/read-only.
evidence.P3: Final-head real read-v4 frames, frozen schema unchanged, exact historical production codec all4directions pass; no physical systemd service claim.
evidence.P4: Final-head actual pre-existing worktree APIcreate201 and browser chooser→canonical row; branch/worktree inventory and tracked sentinel unchanged.
evidence.P5: Actual Chromium virtual enrollment→signout→passkey signin→non-elevated prompt on d7e9804 runtime. Final-head software-authenticator/password-budget HTTP suite also passes. No hardware claim.

acceptance.criterion: Contract test per endpoint against a real Daemon: stop and start land the same row state the local path produced.
acceptance.remaining: Official flag/client/error-catalog cutover is not delivered by this native experiment.

acceptance.criterion: Daemon-unreachable case: the action fails, no local write occurs, and the user sees reconnect guidance.
acceptance.remaining: Fixture proves TUI hard-fail/no local write; official rollout remains pending.

acceptance.criterion: Unknown-outcome case: canonical state is refreshed, the uncertainty is surfaced, and the mutation is not replayed.
acceptance.remaining: No independent lost-response trace is attributed to this final-head probe.

acceptance.criterion: A 409 with `AoE-Error-Code: lifecycle_locked` maps to a lifecycle-conflict outcome, classified without reading the response body.
acceptance.remaining: Ratified D1 classification must converge on the official shared error catalog, not private native codes.

acceptance.criterion: The retired storage paths are gone from `src/tui/stop_poller.rs` and `src/tui/home/pollers.rs`.
acceptance.remaining: Native local writers are retired; official migration-flag retirement sequence is separate.

acceptance.criterion: Existing e2e stop coverage still passes.
acceptance.remaining: Final E2E execution is green; no official ticket closure.

acceptance.criterion: Contract test per endpoint against a real Daemon.
acceptance.remaining: Final suites pass; official per-endpoint cutover contracts remain gated.

acceptance.criterion: A restore-during-purge case asserts the Daemon's outcome is what the row shows (the `KeptRestored` disposition in `src/tui/home/pollers.rs`).
acceptance.remaining: Current lifecycle/contention coverage passes; no new isolated KeptRestored live trace claimed.

acceptance.criterion: A daemon-unreachable case asserts no local deletion occurs.
acceptance.remaining: Target-profile bytes and native input stay fenced while offline.

acceptance.criterion: An unknown-outcome case asserts the operation is not replayed and the row is re-read from the Daemon.
acceptance.remaining: No independent destructive unknown-outcome live trace is attributed to this run.

acceptance.criterion: The TUI's trash and deletion pollers no longer touch storage.
acceptance.remaining: Native authority differs from the future flag-gated official cutover.

acceptance.criterion: Contract test per endpoint against a real Daemon.
acceptance.remaining: Official per-endpoint contract delivery remains separate.

acceptance.criterion: Home-view tests that the optimistic local row and the Daemon's response converge.
acceptance.remaining: Current convergence suites pass; no official local-optimism migration claim.

acceptance.criterion: A daemon-unreachable case asserts the field is not written locally.
acceptance.remaining: Observed target store is unchanged during real TUI disconnection.

acceptance.criterion: An unknown-outcome case asserts canonical state is refreshed and the update is not replayed.
acceptance.remaining: No independent lost-response metadata trace is claimed here.

acceptance.criterion: A favorite endpoint exists, is routed, and has a contract test.
acceptance.remaining: Current native endpoint tests pass; the official ticket remains open.

acceptance.criterion: None outstanding here. #3898 and #3900 carry the live gates.
acceptance.remaining: Maintainer-completed; no outstanding acceptance here. Preserve #4648 and gates moved to #3898/#3900.

acceptance.criterion: Loopback and HTTPS are allowed; a remote plaintext bearer sends no request.
acceptance.remaining: Native transport guards pass; official typed-Principal convergence remains open.

acceptance.criterion: Forged forwarded headers are ignored without proxy mode, including on loopback.
acceptance.remaining: Ingress regression suites pass; not an independent final-head forged-header smoke.

acceptance.criterion: Only explicitly trusted peers influence TLS assertions and client identity in auth, login and rate limiting.
acceptance.remaining: Trusted-ingress policy retained; full official auth-router convergence remains open.

acceptance.criterion: A trusted TLS proxy works; no proxy or name-resolution escape from loopback.
acceptance.remaining: Transport regression suites pass; no real remote TLS deployment is claimed.

acceptance.criterion: No secret-bearing URL, debug output or error source.
acceptance.remaining: Redaction/source guards pass; not a claim about every possible future error.

acceptance.criterion: 401, 403, 404, 409 and 426 cases classify correctly, including the old-server and unknown-header cases; a stalled error body never delays classification.
acceptance.remaining: Private native error codes are not the official D1 catalog acceptance.

acceptance.criterion: Concurrent approval resolution clears only the correct card after safe evidence.
acceptance.remaining: Approval race suites pass; no new real-provider concurrent approval trace.

acceptance.criterion: A trusted loopback HTTPS proxy with absent, malformed or loopback client identity must not bypass login or elevation, in passphrase-only and token-plus-passphrase modes.
acceptance.remaining: Proxy/passkey HTTP regressions and real virtual-passkey non-elevation pass; mode-matrix acceptance stays open.

acceptance.criterion: Existing access middleware is reused; no broad #2735 tiers and no native TLS addition.
acceptance.remaining: No broad ACL tiers or native TLS added; official Principal/router adoption is pending.

acceptance.criterion: Real REST and WS over the Unix socket, on Linux and macOS.
acceptance.remaining: Real Linux owner UDS REST/WS proved; no real macOS Daemon smoke is claimed.

acceptance.criterion: Matching UID accepted; wrong UID and failing credentials rejected.
acceptance.remaining: Matching owner UID is live-proved; no second-UID process experiment in this final run.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime socket directory 0700 and socket 0600, owned by the effective user; unsafe ancestry and symlink substitution refused; a stale socket is distinguished from a live one; a live socket is never unlinked.
acceptance.remaining: Socket/path security suites pass; no independent final-head census of every adversarial ancestry case.

acceptance.criterion: No fabricated TCP or proxy identity; a TCP-forged local header is rejected.
acceptance.remaining: Owner UDS and missing/valid TCP credentials verified; not the full spoofed-header matrix.

acceptance.criterion: Local administrative rights apply, with configured read-only, CityHall and agent restrictions preserved.
acceptance.remaining: Actual read-only/CityHall outcomes pass; official typed-Principal route convergence remains open.

acceptance.criterion: Existing remote HTTPS behaviour is unaffected.
acceptance.remaining: Transport suites pass; no real remote HTTPS deployment claimed.

acceptance.criterion: Any schema or path persistence change uses the project's migration mechanism; a runtime socket alone is not a schema.
acceptance.remaining: Versioned migration suites pass; official socket/Principal convergence is still separate.

acceptance.criterion: Simultaneous TUIs yield one all-profile authority.
acceptance.remaining: Shared spawn-race tests pass; official #4465 remains a dependency.

acceptance.criterion: No dashboard is auto-exposed; the web dashboard is absent and the plugin disabled.
acceptance.remaining: Actual Core binds no TCP listener; no auto-dashboard claim beyond this mode.

acceptance.criterion: The coordinated exposure restart succeeds or fails with the last working configuration retained for explicit rollback.
acceptance.remaining: Lifecycle/restart/rollback tests pass; no new independent rollback incident trace.

acceptance.criterion: Auth mode, read-only, CityHall and allowlists are effective before readiness is reported.
acceptance.remaining: Auth/read-only/CityHall probes pass; not the complete allowlist/readiness matrix.

acceptance.criterion: Managed WS connections close on a policy change.
acceptance.remaining: Existing policy-change WS suites pass; no new independent final-head trace.

acceptance.criterion: Stop, restart and TUI-exit survival behave as specified; an explicit remote endpoint never spawns locally.
acceptance.remaining: Actual TUI exit/survival/reconnect and explicit-unreachable endpoint behavior proved.

acceptance.criterion: A wrong runtime, socket or version is refused.
acceptance.remaining: Handshake tests and old read consumer pass; no full adversarial-version live matrix.

acceptance.criterion: Profile defaults are honoured, and profile rename or delete forces revalidation.
acceptance.remaining: Profile rename/delete/default tests pass; no independent new profile lifecycle trace.

acceptance.criterion: The initial no-snapshot failure, the disconnected unavailable view with live-send and new attach disabled, and the documented independence of a pre-existing native attachment are each verified.
acceptance.remaining: Initial unavailable, disconnected no-input/no-local-write, independent attachment all observed.

acceptance.criterion: Explicit reconnect yields a fresh snapshot; no ambiguous mutation is replayed.
acceptance.remaining: Explicit reconnect changes epoch and restores fresh TUI data; no replay performed.

acceptance.criterion: The local TUI honours negotiated read-only and CityHall policy.
acceptance.remaining: Policy suites/MCP restrictions pass; not an independent actual-TUI policy negotiation matrix.

acceptance.criterion: A disconnect followed by a same-pane respawn cannot trigger input fallback or reacquisition.
acceptance.remaining: Same physical pane replacement cannot recover native input during disconnection.

acceptance.criterion: The live TUI/real-Daemon E2E asserts the hard fail with reconnect guidance. It must pass before #3901 moves the authoritative row set.
acceptance.remaining: Actual TUI and real Daemon hard-fail/reconnect observed; official row-set cutover remains gated.

acceptance.criterion: Agent and host, container and tool ensure paths go through the Daemon.
acceptance.remaining: Native paths pass suites; official shared-client ensure cutover remains separate.

acceptance.criterion: Local attach and live I/O are unchanged for live panes.
acceptance.remaining: Real local native I/O observed; no full live container/tool mode matrix here.

acceptance.criterion: A dead pane cannot respawn while the Daemon is offline.
acceptance.remaining: No fallback input/reacquisition after daemon loss and same-pane replacement.

acceptance.criterion: A socket mismatch cannot touch another tmux server.
acceptance.remaining: Socket mismatch fixtures pass; no independent new second-server attack trace.

acceptance.criterion: Environment comes from the Daemon host with the target profile and repository settings; no later-client or remote-secret leakage.
acceptance.remaining: Environment/profile regression suites pass; no cloud/container secret-bearing runtime claimed.

acceptance.criterion: Local and web clients observe the same canonical result.
acceptance.remaining: Actual browser and owner API create canonical rows on same existing checkout; not every canonical outcome.

acceptance.remaining: 2 s target declared before measurement, not proof of the official pre-removal rollout sequence or a ratified SLO.

acceptance.criterion: Known terminal state transitions are tested against the Daemon and against both clients.
acceptance.remaining: 20 real Daemon/TUI transitions measured; no equivalent jointly timed web-client trace.

acceptance.criterion: Status event and reload ordering is verified.
acceptance.remaining: Ordering suites pass; no independent every-mode event/reload trace.

acceptance.criterion: Reconnect epochs are verified.
acceptance.remaining: Actual reconnect moves to a new epoch and fresh row set.

acceptance.criterion: Persistence with legacy writers still present is verified.
acceptance.remaining: Official persistence coexistence with legacy writers is not delivered by clean-cutover native code.

acceptance.criterion: No freshness SLO is inferred from #3841's measurement, and no UI test count is offered as evidence of a freshness contract.
acceptance.remaining: No #3841-derived SLO or UI-count freshness proof claimed; measured target remains experimental.

acceptance.criterion: Every action in the inventory has a single selected authority.
acceptance.remaining: Native action authority is implemented; official inventory/flag cutover remains dependency-gated.

acceptance.remaining: Receipt/snapshot race tests pass; no new independent rollback scenario claimed.

acceptance.remaining: Profile mutation tests pass; no independent complete cross-profile live matrix.
